recovery_protocol.root_cause: Prior TLS root cause remains unproven. Large-body WriteTimeout was observed. A WebP-only SAM probe failed; a later identical-WebP probe using 64 KiB HTTP writes succeeded without retries in 32.84s. Network conditions may differ, so this is not an isolated causal attribution. No security settings changed.

runtime_changes: Frozen current working-tree runtime. Packaging gate, reusable API client, bounded connect timeout, error types preserved; also includes concurrent EXIF/geometry fixes. Regression on previously seen photos; not a new holdout. This transport run changes only image_input.py relative to that frozen runtime: choose smaller lossless WebP for large PNGs, identical decoded RGB pixels and dimensions. Prior recovery run and SAM-only transport probe retained; this is a regression, not an unseen test. Additionally meta.py splits buffered HTTP request bodies into replayable 64 KiB writes without changing payload bytes, content length or timeouts. A separate zero-retry SAM transport probe on 5183 passed before this run; it was not a gate decision.
